title: River Sampling Protocol
summary: Protocol excerpt with inline method notes and an ordered references block for downstream rendering.

blocks.text: Collect samples upstream first, then proceed downstream so the operator does not disturb the later measurement sites.
Sampling order matters more than speed because the protocol assumes the downstream site remains undisturbed until the end of the run.

entries.text: U.S. Geological Survey. National Field Manual for the Collection of Water-Quality Data. 2023.
World Health Organization. Guidelines for Drinking-water Quality. Fourth edition, 2022.
